text: Bidding commercial jobs from blueprints? Coatwright now does the takeoff and the bid, in one place. Start a new commercial job and choose Price from blueprints.
Open the PDF drawings, straight from your computer. It works on a tablet or phone too.
Coatwright reads the scale printed on the sheet. One click, and you're measuring. If a plan is printed smaller, just measure a known dimension instead.
Pick a paint system, like walls in eggshell, and click around each room. Close the shape, and it multiplies the walls by the height. Square feet, done, and the bid updates as you go.
Ceilings and floors are areas. Outline them, and the square footage adds up.
Doors and frames? Just click each one to count it.
Already measured in Adobe or Bluebeam? Type your totals instead. You get the same bid.

Here's a full office, measured. The bid builds itself: labour hours from your production rates, paint by the pail, extra costs like a lift rental, then overhead and profit. Prefer unit prices? Switch to price per square foot.
Then send a professional proposal: scope by paint system, alternates, inclusions and exclusions, ready to sign, email, or save as a PDF.
Blueprint to bid, in minutes. Coatwright Commercial, now in beta.
